Positive assignment for an allowed distinct referent must be fit=direct and placed in SUPPORT even if the candidate is not famous or not in the first document. A support statement is not a counter. Counter requires an explicit negative/exclusion or incompatible statement about that exact referent, and cannot be justified by absence. A birth header (date1 - date2) supports date1, not merely prose Born on. Distinct people sharing a name, distinct works with one title, multiple sports and plural mascots may legitimately coexist. Role match and truth are separate axes: competing same-role values stay direct with conflict flagged. Unknown memory is not negative evidence.
